Chore playbook — change 0002-chore — agent-executed (ADR 0005); no spec deltas.

Prompt: "tidy the CI matrix"

Execute in order, in a single linear pass:

1. Replace the placeholder tasks in .doctrina/changes/0002-chore/tasks.md
   with small, checkable steps; implement them, checking each box.
   (Do it before implementing — the close refuses leftover scaffold
   placeholders, and `change tick` will not tick an empty box.)
2. Prove it (the close refuses unchecked boxes):
       doctrina verify     — the project's typecheck/test/build gate
       doctrina verify --clean — clean-checkout reproducibility lint
   Then check the proposal's ## Verification boxes and every task.
3. This is a chore: no spec changes. If you find yourself needing a
   spec delta, it is not a chore — reopen with doctrina work "<prompt>".
4. Close in one attested pass — the same close as any change; a chore
   simply has no delta to apply:
       doctrina close 0002-chore
   It stops at the first failure with the exact rerun command, and the
   sequence is printed by the close itself. A chore that alters a
   documented surface still owes the docs and a changelog entry — or
   `- **Documented surface:** n/a — <why>` in the proposal.
   If this fix taught a lesson worth not relearning, capture it: doctrina skill new <slug>.
